description: Permanently delete a sequence. Contacts still in it are removed and get none of its remaining steps; the result's `contactsInSequence` says how many. To stop new entries but let current contacts finish, use `pause_sequence_enrollments` instead, or `disable_sequence` to hold everyone where they are.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: delete_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_sequence` MCP tool.

contactsInSequence.description: Contacts who were still in the sequence (running, waiting or paused). They were removed and get none of its remaining steps.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
